description.narrative: (Cambodia): .FY 2021 funds will be used to educate and train local community members and representatives who will become the advocates for land and natural resources rights, freedom of expression, civil rights, indigenous rights, and advocacy skills. These community members and representatives will support community-led campaigns to advocate for land and natural resource issues and provide venues for fair and peaceful solutions to human rights violations. This activity will promote participation of community members, especially women and youth, in decision-making at the local level; support monitoring and investigation of rights violations, including gender-based violence; and provide protection, legal aid, and representation community representatives and activists who are unjustly persecuted...The activity supports USAID/Cambodia's CDCS 2020-2025 Development Objective 3 "Human rights protected and government accountability advanced," and specially the Intermediate Result 3.1, "Strengthened defense of constitutional and other legal rights" by advancing the respect for and protection of human rights of the Cambodian people. The activity also supports the Administration's priorities under the "Renewing and Championing Democracy and Human Rights," in which the activity seeks to increase knowledge and awareness among marginalized communities on land and natural resource rights, civil liberties, and indigenous rights; build advocacy skills of affected communities and encourage them to engage in collective action to find fair and peaceful solutions to rights violations; and provide legal and other forms of protection to community representatives and activists harassed for asserting rights and seeking redress for abuses. .
